description: Shared Renovate policy for everything running on vanta. Nothing in this estate is ever retired, so the cost of keeping a dormant project has to stay near zero - which means its dependencies must be patched without anyone remembering to look.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes ignore the weekly window and the concurrency cap. outplay alone carried 24 high-severity advisories while dormant.

packageRules.description: Patch and minor bumps merge on their own. A dormant site cannot afford to need attention, and holding these open is how estates rot.
Majors always need a human. They are where the breakage is.
A major Postgres bump is a dump-and-restore, never an image swap. pg-a additionally carries pgBackRest and a WAL archive that must be re-stanza'd.
Node majors change the runtime under every app here. Grouped so they are reviewed as one decision rather than fourteen.
Next.js moves fast and these are production sites. Minors get a PR but not an automerge.
Traefik terminates TLS for the whole estate; a bad automerge takes every site down at once.
